one_liner: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries manufactures and sells pharmaceutical formulations, global innovative medicines, and generics, generating revenue across India, the US, and emerging markets.

segments.name: Global Innovative Medicines
segments.latest: Sales up 6.9% to reach USD356 million, driven by US and ex-US markets.

segments.name: India Formulations
segments.latest: Sales reached INR55,523 million, recording a growth of 17.3%.

segments.name: US Business
segments.latest: Sales reported at USD455 million, declining by 8.2% largely due to lenalidomide erosion.

segments.name: Emerging Markets
segments.latest: Formulation revenue was USD350 million, up by 7.6% over Q2 last year.

segments.name: Rest of the World
segments.latest: Formulation revenues were USD241 million, higher than Q2 last year.

drivers: Strong volume expansions in the India business
Growth across products like Ilumya, Cequa, and Odomzo
Favorable currency tailwinds and better product mix
